title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, cost/latency breakdown dashboard, and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add token-level KV cache metrics, new cost/latency breakdown dashboard, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy paging and improve incident signal-to-noise.
description:
Motivation: We want better visibility into token-level KV cache behavior (hit/miss/eviction), per-token cost and latency breakdowns, and more actionable alerts. This PR adds runtime metrics for KV cache, exports summarized token-level cost/latency histograms, ships a Grafana dashboard for per-route/model token economics, and updates alert rules to reduce noisy paging while preserving SLO coverage. Changes are backward-compatible and guarded by a feature flag (OBS_TOKEN_KV_METRICS).

What I changed: commits + files listed below. Key points: added lightweight atomic counters and sampled histograms in runtime to avoid overhead for high-QPS routes; added agent-side aggregation to reduce cardinality (route/model+cache_bucket); exported Prometheus metrics with stable names; added dashboard JSON and alert rules; added integration tests for metric emission and end-to-end dashboard import instructions in docs.

Risks and mitigation: metric export paths are behind feature flag and default-off for private installer; added unit and integration tests; dashboard is non-destructive configuration JSON for Grafana.

CI / testing: unit tests / e2e metrics tests / lint / build passed on rerun (one flaky test initially failed due to timing on histogram sampling and was fixed by increasing wait in the test harness).

Next steps: monitor dashboards for two weeks, ship feature flag to canary orgs, and iterate on alert thresholds once we have production signal.

review_comments: Luca Moretti (reviewer): Can we confirm cardinality is bounded? The route+model tag combo could explode for customers with many model variants.

Aisha Patel (author): We added aggregation on agent/proxy to bucket models by family and limited label set to [route, model_family, cache_bucket]. Added doc note about cardinality and feature flag to disable emission.
Mei Chen (reviewer): Alert thresholds look reasonable, but we've seen spikes during nightly jobs. Can we add a cooldown for alerts or a suppression window for known batch windows?
Aisha Patel (author): Added suppression rule for masks of nightly job routes and a 30m auto-snooze on repeated flapping (implemented in alerts YAML). Updated runbook to point to batch job exemptions.
Jordan Park (reviewer): One flaky test failure in CI - test_kv_metrics sometimes samples zero due to timing. Consider making the test resilient or use eventual assertions.
Aisha Patel (author): Increased sampling window in integration test and switched to eventually-consistent check. CI rerun passed.
